conditions: The converted path raises an indentation error when the trimmed, comment-filtered line is exactly ここまで.
limitations: This is behavior of the inspected conversion routine in the TypeScript source. Separate syntax parsing stages, runtime builds, and the Go implementation lie outside this claim.

triggers: Publisher correction, changed exact source bytes, revised applicability, or contrary primary evidence.

statement: The TypeScript 3.8.12 indentation converter calls its mode-selected conversion only if its mode helper recognizes !インデント構文 or !ここまでだるい. Otherwise this routine returns the input code unchanged.
